summary: Pony AI Inc., a Cayman-incorporated, weighted-voting-rights foreign private issuer listed in Hong Kong (stock code 02026) and the US, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its October 2026 monthly return to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. The return reports no movement in authorized or issued share capital: Class A ordinary shares held at 354,095,390, Class B at 81,088,770, with zero treasury shares, and confirms compliance with the 10% minimum public float. This is a routine HKEX monthly securities-movement disclosure, not a special situation; no deal, price, or recommendation is stated.
